refusal.ask: Add a birth time and I'll score this match.
refusal.sentence: I can't show a score for this match. When it was scored, one side's Moon sign was undetermined — the record does not say whose — and four of the eight kootas (Varna, Vashya, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot) are read from the Moon's rashi alone. A birth time settles it; add one and I'll match the full chart.
